page_title: HAV 0-1 ANG | Le Havre v Angers 01/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Willy Delajod has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:11.
90+1' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Willy Delajod didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jim Allevinah will be replaced by Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers).
90' The substitution is prepared. Jacques Ekomie (Angers) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Florent Hanin.
89' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Himad Abdelli (Angers) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Esteban Lepaul.
86' Willy Delajod has issued a yellow card to Yassine Kechta (Le Havre).
84' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
84' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Good work from Le Havre as they win a corner.
82' The ball is cleared after Himad Abdelli (Angers) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
80' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) comes onto the pitch for Farid El Melali.
79' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
77' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Josue Casimir is replaced by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
75' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
74' Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
71' Substitution. Ibrahima Niane (Angers) in, Bamba Dieng out.
71' The game is interrupted now, Andre Ayew (Le Havre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
69' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
66' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Willy Delajod to decide it wasn’t handball. The relieved Angers players can finally celebrate.
65' The Angers players halt their celebrations as referee Willy Delajod makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.

63' 0 - 1 Farid El Melali takes over corner duties and expertly finds Himad Abdelli (Angers), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the right side of the goal. The score is now 0:1.
63' Farid El Melali (Angers) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
62' Le Havre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' Didier Digard has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) replacing Daler Kuzyaev.
61' A substitution has been made. Emmanuel Sabbi goes off and Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) comes on.
61' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Corner kick. Le Havre will have an opportunity.
59' A clumsy foul by Carlens Arcus (Angers) and Willy Delajod blows his whistle.
57' 54:46 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

54' Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
50' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yahia Fofana, who smothers the ball.
49' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
48' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' Willy Delajod blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Bamba Dieng (Angers) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
42' The current number of shots on goal is 0:1.
39' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.

37' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is behind the touchline and Le Havre will take a throw-in.
35' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Angers! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Willy Delajod and both teams have no complaints.
34' Referee Willy Delajod makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Angers. Let’s see what happens!
33' Surely that's handball by one of the Le Havre players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
31' Bamba Dieng (Angers) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
30' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but Yahia Fofana comes off his line to gather the ball.
27' The referee blows his whistle as Himad Abdelli (Angers) was too aggressive in his challenge.

24' Bamba Dieng (Angers) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort narrowly wide of the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
23' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) brings an opponent down and Willy Delajod interrupts the game.
23' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre).

22' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
21' The resulting corner from Farid El Melali (Angers) is cleared.
21' Bamba Dieng (Angers) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
20' Farid El Melali (Angers) will take the corner.
19' Jim Allevinah (Angers) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
18' Angers control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
16' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) commits a rough challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for an infringement.
14' Willy Delajod has a clear sight and sees a foul from Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre).
10' Willy Delajod blows his whistle as Farid El Melali (Angers) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
8' Farid El Melali (Angers) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

8' Farid El Melali (Angers) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Angers.
6' Bamba Dieng (Angers) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that crashes into the defensive wall. The opposition's goalkeeper set it up perfectly.
4' Willy Delajod blows his whistle. Issa Soumare (Le Havre) commits a foul after dangerous play.
2' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
1' The match has just started.
Angers will kick the game off.
Willy Delajod will supervise the game today.
